## Result

Describe the concrete change and its exact scope. For research, link the package
and state whether this is a bound improvement, partial result, obstruction, or
tooling contribution. The OpenAI baseline is accepted as true.

## Sources and cost

For research, identify the task, predecessor, source commit and labels. Explain
the changed premise and the complete cost, including any unchanged bottleneck.
For tooling or documentation, describe the resulting behavior.

## Verification

Give the commands actually run and their results. Distinguish finite checks,
conditional cost models, proofs, and independent review. State any unrun checks.

## Remaining work and credit

Record unresolved obligations and the next concrete question, if any.
Retain predecessor attribution and disclose substantial AI assistance.
